introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: Mitsitsy ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our mobile application and website.

appData.title: 2.1 Application Data
appData.content: Mitsitsy is designed with an "offline-first" approach. All your financial data (transactions, accounts, categories, plans) is stored locally on your device only. We do not have access to this data and it is never transmitted to our servers.

newsletter.title: 2.2 Newsletter
newsletter.content: If you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect:
newsletter.usage: This data is used solely to send you information about Mitsitsy (updates, tips, launch news). You can unsubscribe at any time.

dataStorage.title: 3. Data Storage
dataStorage.appData: Application data: Stored locally on your device in a SQLite database. This data never leaves your phone unless you explicitly choose to export it.
dataStorage.newsletterData: Newsletter data: Stored securely on our servers with encryption.

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
dataSharing.noSelling: We never sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.
dataSharing.localOnly: Your financial data in the application stays on your device and is only accessible by you.

yourRights.title: 5. Your Rights
yourRights.contact: To exercise these rights, contact us at: raymond.dzeryhago36@gmail.com

security.title: 6. Security
security.content: We take the security of your data seriously:
items: Your financial data never passes through the internet
Ability to hide your balance to protect your privacy
No ads or trackers in the application

modifications.title: 7. Modifications
modifications.content: We may update this privacy policy. Changes will be published on this page with a new update date.
